title: Kaskaden-Sandbox — interactive evidence-graph for the Wunderling tipping-element network (P87)
description: Interactive evidence-graph sandbox for the published Wunderling et al. tipping-element network (Greenland Ice Sheet / West Antarctic Ice Sheet / AMOC / Amazon rainforest). Companion UI to cascading-tipping-utac (GenesisAeon P87), ported 1:1 from the package's own constants and network module -- all seven documented pairwise couplings, including the two the source papers explicitly leave with an unclear net sign (WAIS-AMOC, AMOC-Amazon), kept unresolved rather than guessed. Deliberately no UTAC/CREP/AFET overlay and no invented Gamma value; a dedicated test suite greps the domain code itself to guarantee that. Part of the GenesisAeon interactive-sandbox series.
